fast_castle_pocket.name: Fast Castle (27+2 Pop)
critical_milestones: Build Market + Blacksmith immediately on hitting Feudal
Seed 6 farms minimum before Castle Age to sustain 2-Stable Knight queue
Double-Bit Axe and Horse Collar teched on Feudal click
common_leaks: TC idle time > 20s delays Castle timing past 15:00
Unwalled woodlines allowing flank scout leak to kill pocket vills

scout_rush_flank.name: Scout Rush (20/21 Pop)
critical_milestones: Stable queued immediately upon Feudal ding
Bloodlines teched if engaging enemy scouts
Wall exterior lumber camp while scouts harass enemy berries/gold
Transition 10-12 villagers to farms to prepare Castle Age click by 18:00 - 20:00
common_leaks: Diving scouts under enemy Town Center (costly loss of 240+ food in units)
Forgetting to wall base while focused on forward micro

archer_rush_flank.name: 2-Range Archer Flush (21/22 Pop)
critical_milestones: Gather 8-10 archers before moving out across mid-map
Maintain continuous production from 2 Archery Ranges (requires 7-8 gold vills, 10 wood vills)
Instant Bodkin Arrow + Crossbow upgrade clicked upon hitting Castle Age
common_leaks: Missing Fletching upgrade (+1 attack and range makes archers defeat unarmored skirmishers)
Getting caught out of position by pocket knights with +1 armor
